# Open Justice Oklahoma

> > Open Justice Oklahoma provides public data tools and tracking systems to advance transparency and accountability in Oklahoma's criminal justice system.

Open Justice Oklahoma is a project of the Oklahoma Policy Institute that leverages data and technology to make court and corrections information accessible to the public. The platform includes specialized tracking tools for monitoring court cases, bail decisions, and incarceration data to support criminal justice reform advocacy.
